At a convenience store, $5$ customers arrive per hour on average. What is the probability that the $3$rd customer will arrive within an hour of the store opening? Round your answer to $4$ decimal places. You may assume arrivals occur continuously in time, independently, and at a constant average rate.

*Hint: You may use the fact that*
$\displaystyle \int_{0}^{1}x^{2}e^{-5x}dx \approx 0.014006$.

*A gamma random variable $X∼Γ(α, λ)$ with shape parameter $α$ and rate parameter $λ$ has the following probability density function:*

$f(x) = {(λ^{α})/(Γ(α))x^{α - 1}e^{- λx},\begin{vmatrix}x > 0 \\ 0,\end{vmatrix}otherwise$
*where $Γ(α)$ is the gamma function.*

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.

At a particular underwater location, earthquakes occur every $3$ months on average. What is the probability that the $2$nd earthquake will occur at least $2$ months after the start of the observations? Round your answer to $4$ decimal places. You may assume earthquakes occur continuously in time, independently, and at a constant average rate.

*Hint: You may use the fact that*
$\displaystyle \int_{2}^{∞}xe^{-x/3}dx \approx 7.701257$.

*A gamma random variable $X∼Γ(α, λ)$ with shape parameter $α$ and rate parameter $λ$ has the following probability density function:*

$f(x) = {(λ^{α})/(Γ(α))x^{α - 1}e^{- λx},\begin{vmatrix}x > 0 \\ 0,\end{vmatrix}otherwise$
*where $Γ(α)$ is the gamma function.*

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
